robot: OpenArm 2.0 (Enactic), a pair of 7-DoF arms on a gallows; this kit: the loose units of both arms (see NOTICE)
units_note: metres, kilograms; every file in the unit's own frame (the arm frame's axes, its root body's origin)

units.role: J1 link: the bracket bolted onto J1's output flange; carries the J2 motor's yoke
J2 motor (DM-J8009P-2EC, 99 mm disc), with its output flange (rotor R2); seats in J1 link's yoke
J2 link: bolted onto J2's output flange; its other end is J3's output side
upper arm: J3 motor (its rotor R3 bolts onto J2 link), the J4 motor (rotor R4) and J4_D, the forearm's second support, free on a bearing (J4_B) on the far side
forearm: bolted onto J4's output flange and onto J4_D together; carries the J5 motor (rotor R5)
J4 cable holder A: a plate over J4, seated on the forearm's J4_E side
J4 cable holder B: a plate over J4, seated on J4_D (the upper arm's bearing side)
wrist: J5's output side with the J6 joint and the J7 motor (rotor R7)
end effector: the gripper (J7 adapter, its motor and two fingers); bolted onto J7's output flange
J1 link: the bracket bolted onto J1's output flange; carries the J2 motor's yoke
J2 motor (DM-J8009P-2EC, 99 mm disc), with its output flange (rotor R2); seats in J1 link's yoke
J2 link: bolted onto J2's output flange; its other end is J3's output side
upper arm: J3 motor (its rotor R3 bolts onto J2 link), the J4 motor (rotor R4) and J4_D, the forearm's second support, free on a bearing (J4_B) on the far side
forearm: bolted onto J4's output flange and onto J4_D together; carries the J5 motor (rotor R5)
J4 cable holder A: a plate over J4, seated on the forearm's J4_E side
J4 cable holder B: a plate over J4, seated on J4_D (the upper arm's bearing side)
wrist: J5's output side with the J6 joint and the J7 motor (rotor R7)
end effector: the gripper (J7 adapter, its motor and two fingers); bolted onto J7's output flange

l_j4b.bearing: J4_D on the FL6803ZZ bearing in J4_B

r_j4b.bearing: J4_D on the FL6803ZZ bearing in J4_B

design.note: the pair frame (the arms' common root, 0.697 m above the gallows' base plate) in the cell frame with the gallows at its nominal place; each episode shifts the gallows by up to 10 mm. Unit poses are in the pair frame at the zero posture (every joint at 0).

fastening.rule: a unit on its feature is held there by the cell (ENGAGED: within 4 mm across and 8 deg; a flange also within 4 mm along its axis, its rotation about the axis left free; the J2 motor's seat at most 3 mm short of home); it fastens (the screws) when it rests within its tolerance for 50 consecutive 10 ms ticks, moving slower than 5 mm/s and 2 deg/s relative to its carrier. A flange is bolted at the nearest bolt position (every 60 deg); it counts only on its design bolt position (the rotor's yellow index mark against the part's). A mate with `also_fastens` (the forearm) needs the other body (J4_D) within the tolerance too. Nothing is reported to the program.
fastening.powered_joints: J1, J2 and J3 of each arm hold the angle they were fastened at while the arm is built (a position hold, up to 10 / 10 / 5 N m); J4-J7 and J4_D's bearing are unpowered and back-drive against their friction

risers.note: some units rest on two loose aluminium blocks (a riser) under their ends, so that a finger reaches under their edges; the J2 motors stand on their rim between two such blocks (a cradle)
